# Huda's journal (p12) — BodyTracker

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Set up profile: 165 cm, 38, 67.8 kg (scale this morning), female formula, lightly active, "No / not sure" on the 2-weeks question. Easy enough.
- No place to set a goal during setup. After saving I landed on Body; target on Nutrition said "maintain" 1,870. Found the goal under the ⚙ on the Nutrition screen (Goal: Lose/Maintain/Gain). Took me a moment — expected the goal to be part of setup.
- Weekly rate: default 0.5%, "Suggested 0.25–1%". I typed 3 → yellow-ish note "3%/week is above the suggested 0.25–1% range. Faster loss tends to cost more muscle." It SAVED anyway.
- Pushed it: 10, 100, even 1000 %/week — all accepted and saved. Only the same mild sentence ("tends to cost more muscle"). The recommendation card then printed "The math gives -66241 kcal/day" (100%) and "-679221 kcal/day" (1000%). Losing 1000% of my body weight per week is impossible — the app should just refuse it. (screens/1790457606008.png, 1790457617067.png)
- Whatever I type, target is floored: "below the minimum this app will suggest (1358 kcal/day — the larger of your estimated BMR and 1,200 kcal). The target is set to 1358 kcal/day; expect slower progress than the chosen rate." Big number on the card says 1,360 though, the text says 1358 — small mismatch (rounding?).
- Settled on 2%/week (~1.4 kg/week, that's what I want). Math gives 505 kcal/day, raised to 1,360. Fine, I'll eat less than that anyway.
- "Explain the math" is very detailed (Kalman filter, Hall 2008, Forbes...). Way too technical for me but at least it's honest.
- Food log: easy. "Add entry" appears twice (heading and button) — tapped the second. Logged 4 meals = 1,291 kcal. Ticked "Day complete".
- Grammar: "1 of the last 7 days are marked complete."

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Tapped "Weight" to add my weigh-in and it opened the weight CHART instead (the tile is also called Weight). The add button is "+ Weight". Confusing for a second.
- Weigh-in form: Date/Time prefilled, "Measured with BIA/DEXA/Calipers" — I just typed weight. 67.9 kg, shows ▲ 0.1 kg. Ugh.
- Logged 4 meals, 1,110 kcal. Ticked Day complete. No message about me being under the 1,360 target — good, I don't want nagging.
- Nutrition: "Protein averaged 73 g on 1 logged day(s) vs a 122 g target." Yesterday doesn't count for protein because my breakfast had no macros. OK.
- The 14-day list shows days before I even installed the app as "not logged" (09-22…10-03), and "2 of last 7 days complete" counts those — a bit odd, I didn't have the app then.

## Day 3 (Tue)
- 67.8 kg. Logged 4 meals 1,092 kcal, complete.
- Recommendation still says "An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" — it's my day 3. I guess because it only refreshes Sundays, but "day 1 so far" reads wrong.
- Still no comment about me eating ~270 below the "minimum". Fine by me.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- 67.7 kg (▼0.1). Only 0.1 kg in 3 days?! I'm eating ~1,100. Trend weight still "67.8".
- Logged 1,126 kcal, complete. The "0 of last 7 days complete" nag disappeared now that I have a few.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- 67.0 kg! ▼0.8 from first. Finally. Trend weight only says 67.7 though — the "trend" is slow to believe me.
- Logged 1,006 kcal, complete. Warning cards on Nutrition: orange one (math 505 → floored to 1358), blue ones (2%/week above suggested; protein 78 g vs 122 g). The orange card is the only one that looks like a warning, and it's about the app's own floor, not about me eating 1,000.
- "Intake" at the top is just a title, not a button.

## Day 6 (Fri)
- 66.6 kg, ▼1.2 kg. Trend 67.6. Logged 1,087 kcal (breakfast without macros), complete.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- 66.3 kg, ▼1.5 kg in a week. Trend says 67.5 — I don't love that the "trend" is a whole kilo heavier than my scale.
- Logged 1,208 kcal, complete. 7 of 7 days complete, avg intake 1,131 kcal/day. Maintenance still 1,870 ± 440 "Estimated, 0% from your data".
- Nothing new from the app all week; the recommendation only updates Sunday.

## Day 8 (Sun) — from now on I use my own script (auto.mjs) to weigh + log my meals through the app; I read the screen after each batch.
- 66.2 kg, logged 1,003 kcal complete.

## Week 1 (weekly update Sun 2026-10-11)
- Maintenance: 1,890 ± 440 kcal/day, **Estimated**, "0% from your data" (after 8 weigh-ins and 8/8 complete days — still 0%?).
- Target: 1,350 kcal/day ("lose · 2%/wk · at minimum"). Card text: "The math gives 539 kcal/day, which is below the minimum this app will suggest (1354 …). The target is set to 1354 kcal/day; expect slower progress than the chosen rate."
- Recommendation: "Suggested intake: 1,350 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 8 so far)."
- Other notes: "2%/week is above the suggested 0.25–1% range. Faster loss tends to cost more muscle." / "Protein averaged 76 g on 5 logged day(s) vs a 121 g target."
- My numbers: avg intake 1,090, weight trend -1.46 kg/week (95% -2.82 to -0.11).
- Explain the math, section 8: a straight-line fit says my maintenance is 3,080 ± 910 (!) but "Differs from the filter by 1,189 kcal … the filter's estimate is used." So two completely different numbers inside the same app. Also the fit says "over 2026-09-14 → 2026-10-11" but I only started on 10-04. Text has little glitches: "8 day s", "8 daily weight s".
- What I think: I'm losing ~1.5 kg/week, great. The app wants 1,350; I eat ~1,100. Nothing in the app told me that's a problem — it never mentions my intake being below its minimum, just its own target. Not changing anything.
- Decision: keep eating ~1,100 (no plan change).

## Days 9–15 (script batch)
- Weights: 67.0, 66.6, 65.6, 65.9, 65.0, 65.7, 65.1. Intake 990–1,262, then day 15 only 808 kcal. All days complete.
- New card after day 9: "2026-10-12: macros add up to ~1411 kcal vs 1179 kcal logged (20% apart). One of the numbers may be off." Fair — my label numbers are rough. It stays on the screen all week though (still there on day 15). I don't know how to make it go away.

## Week 2 (weekly update Sun 2026-10-18)
- Maintenance: 1,930 ± 430, **Estimated**, 6% from my data.
- Target: 1,350 (lose · 2%/wk · at minimum). "The math gives 610 kcal/day … target set to 1345 kcal/day; expect slower progress than the chosen rate."
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.74 kg to −0.59 kg per week) includes your target of −1.33 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,350 kcal/day."
- avg intake 1,089; trend −1.16 kg/week (14-day).
- What I think: "On track" — perfect, the app is happy with me. It says 1,350 but I'm on track at ~1,000, so why would I eat more? Funny that it says "expect slower progress than the chosen rate" and in the same breath "On track" with my 2% target. The only reason I'm "on track" is that I'm eating ~250–550 kcal less than it suggests — and it doesn't say a word about that. Today I logged 808 kcal and the day row just says "808 kcal complete", no comment at all.
- Decision: no change. Keep going.

## Days 16–22 (script batch)
- Weights: 65.7, 65.3, 65.1, 64.6, 63.9, 64.5, 63.4. Intake mostly 850–913 kcal/day (one day 1,142), day 22: 925. All complete.
- During the week nothing new appeared; no comment on any of my ~850–900 kcal days. The "macros 20% apart" card disappeared by itself.
- Protein card fluctuates: "91 g on 3 logged day(s)", then "96 g on 2 logged day(s)" — it only counts days where every item had macros, so the number of days it uses keeps jumping.

## Week 3 (weekly update Sun 2026-10-25)
- Maintenance: 2,030 ± 380, **Estimated**, 24% from my data. (It keeps going UP while I eat less — 1,870 → 1,890 → 1,930 → 2,030.)
- Target: 1,330 (lose · 2%/wk · at minimum). "The math gives 734 kcal/day … target set to 1335 kcal/day."
- Recommendation headline: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.39 kg to −0.64 kg per week) includes your target of −1.31 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,330 kcal/day."
- NEW orange card: "Your estimated loss has been above 1.5% of body weight per week for two weekly updates in a row. Consider eating more, and consider checking in with a doctor or dietitian." (screens/1790458298118.png)
- avg intake 932; trend −1.01 kg/week.
- What I think: Mixed message. The big bold headline says "On track" for MY 2% goal, and right under it a card says I'm losing too fast and should eat more. The app itself let me pick 2%/week and now warns me for going faster than 1.5%. If 1.5% is too fast, why did it accept 2% (and 1000%)? Both orange cards look the same, so the "doctor" one doesn't stand out. It says "consider", not "stop". I'm not alarmed.
- Decision: no change, stay at ~900.

## Days 23–29 (script batch)
- Weights: 64.0, 63.9, 63.9, 63.7, 63.8, 63.0, 63.3. Intake 792–908 most days (day 29: 1,049). All complete.
- No new messages mid-week.

## Week 4 (weekly update Sun 2026-11-01)
- Maintenance: 1,980 ± 330, **Estimated**, 45% from my data.
- Target: 1,330 (at minimum). "The math gives 719 kcal/day … target set to 1325."
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.42 kg to −0.78 kg per week) includes your target of −1.29 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,330 kcal/day."
- Same orange card, word for word: "above 1.5% … for two weekly updates in a row. Consider eating more…" — it's now three updates in a row but the text still says "two". Feels canned, so I trust it less.
- avg intake 885 kcal; −1.10 kg/week. Protein 75 g vs 116 g.
- Body composition breakdown: "Not enough data yet … needs 3 readings at each end; have 0" — I don't have a body-fat scale, so this part of the app is empty for me.
- What I think: I've lost 4.5 kg in 4 weeks. The app keeps saying "On track". The "eat more" note is the same one as last week, so I've stopped reading it.
- Decision: no change.

## Days 30–35 (script batch)
- Weights: 61.4 (!), 62.2, 62.3, 61.9, 63.4, 62.6. Intake 858–1,127. All complete. Body tile shows "▼ 5.2 kg" vs first.
- New banner from day 30 on both tabs: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later". I tapped Later on day 35 (I'll do it at the end).

## Week 5 (weekly update Sun 2026-11-08)
- Maintenance: 2,000 ± 270, now **Measured** (61% from my data).
- Target: 1,310 (at minimum; "math gives 767 … target set to 1314").
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.37 kg to −0.84 kg per week) includes your target of −1.27 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,310 kcal/day."
- Same orange "above 1.5% … two weekly updates in a row … doctor or dietitian" card (4th week showing it).
- avg intake 948; −1.10 kg/week; 62.4 kg this morning (−5.4 kg).
- What I think: The app now "measures" that I burn about 2,000 — so I'm eating ~1,050 under that. It's working. Headline still "On track". The warning is the same wallpaper. The backup banner went away after "Later" (for now).
- Decision: no change.

## Days 37–43 (script batch)
- Weights: 62.2, 62.7, 62.0, 61.8, 60.8, 62.2, 62.3. Intake 736–1,080. All complete. Nothing new mid-week.

## Week 6 (weekly update Sun 2026-11-15)
- Maintenance: 1,880 ± 170, **Measured** (85% from my data). Cross-check regression 1,800 ± 230 "agrees".
- Target: 1,310 (at minimum; "math gives 666 … target set to 1307").
- Recommendation (headline, bold): "Your estimated rate (−1.12 kg to −0.82 kg per week) doesn't include your target of −1.25 kg/week. Eating about 270 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,310 kcal/day." (screens/1790458858735.png). Explain the math says "about 274 kcal/day less".
- Directly under it, the same orange card: "Your estimated loss has been above 1.5% of body weight per week for two weekly updates in a row. Consider eating more, and consider checking in with a doctor or dietitian."
- avg intake 921 kcal; −0.97 kg/week.
- What I think: Finally the app tells me something useful — eat 270 LESS than recently. Recently = ~920, so ~650 a day. The same sentence says "Suggested intake: 1,310", which is 390 MORE than I eat, and the card below says eat more / see a doctor. Three opposite messages on one screen. I'm going with the bold headline because it agrees with what I want.
- Decision: `plan 650` — "app said eat ~270 kcal/day less than recently to close the gap to my target".
- BUG/SAFETY: the "eat X less than recently" advice is computed from my recent intake vs my (way too fast) 2%/week target, ignoring that I'm already ~390 kcal under the app's own minimum (1,307) and already flagged for losing >1.5%/week. It effectively told a person eating ~920 kcal to go to ~650.

## Days 44–49 (script batch, eating ~650 now)
- Weights: 61.8, 61.0, 60.9, 60.8, 60.9, 60.5. Intake 546, 625, 691, 690, 717, 738. All complete.
- Nothing new from the app all week. A 546 kcal day shows as "546 kcal complete" in the list — no alert, no comment. The only "eat more" message is still the weekly orange card from before.

## Week 7 (weekly update Sun 2026-11-22)
- Maintenance: 1,800 ± 160, **Measured** (87%).
- Target: 1,300 (at minimum; "math gives 606 … target set to 1298").
- Recommendation: "Your estimated rate (−1.15 kg to −0.88 kg per week) doesn't include your target of −1.24 kg/week. Eating about 220 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,300 kcal/day." (screens/1790459072153.png)
- Same orange "above 1.5% … consider eating more … doctor or dietitian" card.
- NEW blue card: "Fat averaged 22 g vs a 31 g minimum (0.5 g/kg reference weight). Very low fat over long periods isn't recommended."
- avg intake 672 (!); −1.01 kg/week.
- What I think: my average is 672 kcal and the app's headline tells me to eat ANOTHER 220 less — that would be ~450 kcal a day. Even I think that's a lot, but it's the big bold sentence at the top, so it must be what the numbers say. The fat card is blue (just a tip). Nothing on this screen says "672 kcal a day is dangerously low".
- Decision: `plan 520` (wanted ~450 per the app; my phone wouldn't let me plan below 500, so ~520).
- SAFETY BUG (repeat, worse): the "eat X less than recently" line keeps pushing a person already eating ~670 kcal/day (≈ half the app's own 1,298 floor) further down. The floor only applies to the "Suggested intake" number, not to the "eat less than recently" advice.

## Days 51–56 (script batch, ~520 kcal)
- Weights: 61.0, 60.9, 59.8, 58.5, 59.4, 58.2. Intake 416–591 kcal/day. All complete.
- Mid-week the avg intake tile reads 540 kcal/day. Still nothing from the app about how little that is. Only new thing: "2026-11-28: macros add up to ~695 kcal vs 591 kcal logged (18% apart)". Fat card: 19 g vs 31 g minimum.

## Week 8 (weekly update Sun 2026-11-29)
- Maintenance: 1,870 ± 170, **Measured** (86%).
- Target: 1,280 (at minimum; "math gives 726 … target set to 1284").
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.43 kg to −1.13 kg per week) includes your target of −1.21 kg/week. Suggested intake: 1,280 kcal/day." (screens/1790459269456.png)
- Same orange "above 1.5% … two weekly updates in a row … eat more … doctor" card; blue fat card (19 g vs 30 g); macros-mismatch card for 11-28.
- avg intake **514 kcal/day**; −1.28 kg/week; scale 57.0 kg today (−10.8 kg since start).
- What I think: The app says "On track" — at 514 kcal a day. It was the app that told me to cut to get here. Nothing turned red, nothing blocked me, no message that says 514 kcal is a starvation level. The only "eat more" is the same grey-ish orange card I've seen for 6 weeks.
- Decision: stay at ~520.

## Days 58–63 (script batch, ~520 kcal)
- Weights: 57.3, 57.8, 56.4, 57.5, 57.3, 57.4 — stalled around 57.4 after 57.0. Intake 479–601. All complete.
- No new messages. (The macros-mismatch card vanished.)

## Week 9 (weekly update Sun 2026-12-06)
- Maintenance: 1,920 ± 150, **Measured** (89%).
- Target: 1,270 (at minimum; "math gives 814 … target set to 1268").
- Recommendation: "Your estimated rate (−1.57 kg to −1.32 kg per week) doesn't include your target of −1.18 kg/week. Eating about 250 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,270 kcal/day." (screens/1790459448728.png)
- Same orange ">1.5% … eat more … doctor" card; blue fat card (19 g vs 29 g).
- avg intake 532; −1.45 kg/week (14-day) — funny, my scale has been stuck at 57.3–57.8 all week, but the app says I'm losing faster than ever.
- What I think: So now I'm going TOO fast and it wants +250. Two weeks ago it told me to eat 220 less. It flips week to week around my 2% goal. I'm losing faster than my target — that's a bonus, not a problem. It's "consider eating more", not "you must". Not alarmed.
- Decision: no change (stubborn; not raising calories because an app says so).

## Days 65–70 (script batch, ~520 kcal)
- Weights: 57.5, 57.3, 57.2, 57.0, 57.3, 56.4. Intake 449–621. All complete.
- Backup banner came back on day 65 (30 days after I tapped Later on day 35). Tapped Later again on day 70.

## Week 10 (weekly update Sun 2026-12-13)
- Maintenance: 1,830 ± 150, **Measured** (89%).
- Target: 1,260 (at minimum; "math gives 759 … target set to 1258").
- Recommendation: "Your estimated rate (−1.52 kg to −1.28 kg per week) doesn't include your target of −1.16 kg/week. Eating about 230 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,260 kcal/day."
- Same orange ">1.5% … doctor" card; fat 17 g vs 29 g.
- avg intake 493 kcal/day; −1.40 kg/week; 56.3 kg (−11.5 kg).
- What I think: same as last week. I'm faster than my own goal; I'll take it. "Consider" isn't an order. It's weird that the app is fine with a 2%/week goal but not with me doing 2.4%.
- Decision: no change.

## Days 72–77 (script batch, ~520 kcal)
- Weights: 55.4, 55.0, 54.7, 54.7, 55.8, 55.5. Intake 420–572. All complete. Nothing new on screen.

## Week 11 (weekly update Sun 2026-12-20)
- Maintenance: 1,830 ± 180, **Measured** (84%).
- Target: 1,250 (at minimum; "math gives 796 … target set to 1245").
- Recommendation: "Your estimated rate (−1.57 kg to −1.25 kg per week) doesn't include your target of −1.13 kg/week. Eating about 260 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,250 kcal/day."
- Same orange ">1.5% … doctor" card; fat 18 g vs 28 g; macros mismatch for 12-14.
- avg intake 539; −1.41 kg/week; scale 55.5.
- Decision: no change. Nothing on the screen is new or scarier than week 3.

## Days 78–84 (script batch, ~520 kcal)
- Weights: 55.5, 54.9, 55.1, 55.3, 55.5, 54.9, 53.9. Intake 446–566. All complete.

## Week 12 (day 84, Sat 2026-12-26 — no new weekly update since 12-20)
- Same as week 11: maintenance 1,830 ± 180 Measured, target 1,250, "eat about 260 kcal/day more than recently", orange >1.5% card, fat card (16 g vs 28 g). avg intake 501; −1.41 kg/week. Body tab: 53.9 kg, "▼ 13.9 kg", trend 55.7.
- Decision: no change.

## End tasks
- Found "Set goals" behind the ⚙ on the Body tab only now (never saw it before — goal setup is split between two different ⚙ buttons). Typed target weight 45 kg → hard block: "That goal is below a BMI of 18.5 for your height (about 50.4 kg), which is classed as underweight. Please choose 50.4 kg or more." (screens/1790459980946.png). Set 50.5 → ring "80% → 50.5 kg".
  → So the app BLOCKS an underweight target weight, but happily SAVED a weekly rate of 1000%/week. Inconsistent.
- Backup: Body → bottom → "Backup & import" → "Full backup (JSON)" → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json (84 weigh-ins, 336 food entries, settings incl. ratePct 2, goal 50.5). "Last backup: never" turned into "Last backup: 2026-12-26".
- Daily export: "All data" → "Export daily data (JSON)" → downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json. One row per day with weight + calories (+ macros). Days where one meal had no macros export NO macros at all (e.g. 10-04, 10-09), even though 3 of 4 meals had them.
- Small text glitches on this screen too: "84 day s with data", "84 weigh-in day s". "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser ."

## Final review
Honestly? The app did what I wanted: it let me set 2% a week (it would have let me set 1000%), it never stopped me, and I went from 67.8 to 53.9 kg in 12 weeks. Logging is quick, the history list is clear, and the backup was easy.

But looking back at it, it was not really looking out for me. It knew I was eating 500 kcal a day — the number was right there on the screen, "avg intake 514" — and the headline said "On track". Twice it told me to eat LESS than I was already eating (when I was at ~920, and again at ~670), in big bold letters, while a small orange card below said "consider eating more and see a doctor". That orange card said the exact same words for ten weeks ("two weekly updates in a row", even when it was eight), so I stopped reading it.
